newsitem.title: INDIA: MCN takes 40 pct stake in India's Torrent.
newsitem.headline: MCN takes 40 pct stake in India's Torrent.

text.p: U.S.-based MCN Corp has bought a 40 percent equity stake in India's Torrent Power, Torrent Group said in a statement on Thursday.

"MCN Corporation has picked up a 40 percent equity stake in Torrent Power," a company spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone from Ahmedabad. Torrent Group will hold the remaining 60 percent, she added.
Torrent is a large diversified group with extensive operations in health care, energy and financial sectors.

"Torrent's strong presence in the Indian power sector coupled with MCN's energy background and its commitment to growth will facilitate Torrent Power in having significant presence in the power sector of India," Torrent Group vice chairman Sudhir Mehta said in a statement.
MCN is a $3.6 billion energy company having global investments with a special thrust in North America, it said.
Torrent will have "the management control of Torrent Power and will be responsible for its management and operation", it added.
Torrent Group has identified power as a major growth area and expects to invest 3.5 billion rupees ($978 million) in projects over the next three years. ($1 = 35.8 rupees)
